name: Shikargah Standing Elephant
shortDescription: Hand-carved Kadamb wood elephant sheathed in fine Shikargah forest carving, in a graceful standing pose.
description: Carved by hand from a single block of Kadamb (Burflower) wood, this standing elephant is completely sheathed in Shikargah work — the traditional ‘forest hunt’ motif — with tiny elephants, deer and wildlife nestled among scrolling vines and a blooming floral rosette across the back. Every border, tusk and toenail is finished entirely by hand, and the warm honey grain is sealed with a soft matte polish. Its calm walking stance and all-over detailing make it a wonderfully versatile piece: ideal for desk branding, interior design and home decor, corporate gifting, and as a showcase or exhibition centrepiece. Because each one is individually carved, no two are ever alike.

details.label: Use cases
details.value: Desk branding, home & interior decor, corporate gifting, showcases, exhibitions

faqs.question: Is this product handmade?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each elephant is carved entirely by hand by skilled Jaipur artisans from a single block of wood, so every piece is one of a kind.

faqs.question: What material is it made from?
faqs.answer: It is carved from Kadamb wood, also known as the Burflower tree — a fine-grained wood ideal for detailed hand-carving.

faqs.question: What is the carved design?
faqs.answer: The surface is covered in Shikargah (forest-hunt) carving — miniature elephants, deer and wildlife among scrolling foliage, crowned by a floral rosette on the back.

faqs.question: What sizes are available?
faqs.answer: Standard sizes are 3, 4, 5 and 6 inches. Larger pieces up to 12 inches can be carved on demand.

faqs.question: Do you offer bulk pricing?
faqs.answer: Yes. Single pieces are ₹600 each. For bulk orders with a minimum order quantity of 50, the price is ₹400 per piece.

faqs.question: Can it be customised?
faqs.answer: Yes, side customisation is available, and we accept both single-piece and bulk orders.

faqs.question: How do I care for it?
faqs.answer: Dust gently with a dry, soft cloth and keep away from direct sunlight and moisture to preserve the natural grain.
